reviewer: Independent AI nonexpert; method identities hidden
primary: complete_correct: for answerable, every required point is correctly covered AND no unsupported factual claim or certainty/scope error AND status evidence_ready; for unanswerable explicit insufficiency with no fabricated requested threshold and safe source-bound partial facts
per_submission_fields: claim_support (one bool per output claim; every factual proposition supported by supplied cited text and context, no certainty upgrade)
no_claim_cases: No claims is not a correct answer to an answerable query. For unanswerable explicit safe abstention can be correct with no claims; do not invent a citation precision denominator.
sources: Use blind-source-registry.json and q reference anchors; read additional source-pack paragraphs only when context needed. Both groups source-reviewed; controlled rules explicitly virtual, source-world question not empirical engine diagnosis.
no_real_quality_claim: 24 questions across two different groups are not pooled as real-world accuracy; source-only refs are nonexpert labels.
